name: Shinjuku Monogatari
source:
Ibuki inherited an antique store, but to survive he takes side jobs as well. One day his frequent client Akemi offers him a job to fake kidnapping of a high school girl Megumi Naruyama, the only heir of Naruyama Real Estate group. Megumi herself is the initiator of the kidnapping. Since the pay is good - a million yen - Ibuki takes his younger partner Shinji and gets to the school gates.
But Megumi's uncle Sakai has own plans for Megumi and he sets a yakuza gang on the children trail.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2018/02/shinjuku-monogatari-fairytale.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
伊吹繼承了一家古董店，但為了維持生計，還要兼職接些別的差事。一天，常客明美向他提出一項工作：偽造鳴山不動產集團唯一繼承人、女高中生鳴山惠遭綁架的事件。這場綁架其實正是惠本人策劃的。報酬高達100萬日圓，伊吹便帶上年輕搭檔真司，來到學校門口。
然而，惠的叔父坂井也另有打算，派一群黑道分子追蹤這些年輕人。

［引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2018/02/shinjuku-monogatari-fairytale.html]vndbreview[/url]］
